tester.deciding_evidence: the plus opened a New Message screen, matching the create-new convention in the context of the Messages heading

personas.expectation: It creates something new. I guess a new message, because this is the Messages screen, but it could be a new group or a new friend.
personas.cue: Only the plus sign. There is no word.
personas.why: A plus sign means 'add' or 'new' but not 'new what'. It is right next to 'Add Friends', which also adds something, so I cannot tell how the two differ.
personas.solution: Put a word next to the plus, for example 'New Message', so it is clear how it differs from 'Add Friends'.

personas.expectation: It adds or starts something new. Possibly a new conversation, possibly another way to add a friend.

personas.solution: A word on it, such as 'New message', so I know what it creates.

personas.expectation: It starts something new - probably a new message, because I am on the Messages screen.
personas.cue: Only a plus sign and the 'Messages' heading above it.
personas.why: A plus sign just means 'add' or 'new', and this screen has several things I could add: a friend (the button right next to it already says that), a message, a group. There is another plus in the left column as well. I would read this over and over without committing.
personas.solution: Label it in words, for example 'New Message', so it cannot be confused with 'Add Friends' beside it or with the plus in the left column.

personas.expectation: Probably starts a new message or chat.
personas.cue: Just a plus, sitting on a Messages page.
personas.why: There's already an Add Friends button right beside it, so two 'add' things in one row - I don't know if the plus adds a friend, a message or a group. I'd stall there choosing.
personas.solution: Put a word on it, like 'New message', or give it a clearly different picture from Add Friends.

screen1-a5.appearance: "ATs" (initials on a rounded tile; three identical tiles in the rail)

tester.deciding_evidence: identical 'ATs' tiles lead to identically named, identically laid-out servers; nothing visible says what a tile is or which is which
tester.recommendation: show the full server name under or beside each tile (and a 'Servers' caption on the rail); give each server a distinct visible name or icon

personas.expectation: It opens one of my servers or groups, I think. I cannot tell which one, because all three say 'ATs'.
personas.cue: The letters 'ATs' and the fact that they sit in a column under the messages button. Nothing else.
personas.why: 'ATs' is an abbreviation I have to decode, and three buttons with exactly the same text look like the same thing. I would have to press each one to find out which is which.
personas.solution: Show the full name of each item, and make the three distinguishable, for example with the full server name as visible text under each square.

personas.expectation: I have no idea. Perhaps it opens some group or account called 'ATs'.
personas.cue: Only the letters 'ATs' on a grey square. There are three squares that all say exactly the same thing.
personas.why: 'ATs' is an abbreviation I do not know, and there are three of them identical to each other. I cannot tell which is which, nor what any of them is. I would not remember which one I pressed last time.
personas.solution: Each square should carry its full name in ordinary words, and no two should look the same. A heading over the column saying what the list is would help.

personas.expectation: It opens something called 'ATs' - perhaps a group or server.
personas.cue: Only the letters 'ATs'.
personas.why: There are three tiles that look exactly the same and all say 'ATs'. I cannot tell which is which, I do not know what 'ATs' stands for, and I cannot tell them apart by voice either - saying 'ATs' would not pick one. I would not know which to press.
personas.solution: Show each one's full name, and make each name different so I can tell them apart and say them aloud.

personas.expectation: Opens whatever 'ATs' is - I'd guess a group or space I belong to.
personas.cue: Only the letters ATs, and they sit in the column under the messages button.
personas.why: All three look exactly the same with the same letters, so I can't tell which one is which or where I'd land. I'd have to tap each one to find out.
personas.solution: Show a full name for each one, or at least make them look different from each other.

screen1-a5.recommendation: show the full server name under or beside each tile (and a 'Servers' caption on the rail); give each server a distinct visible name or icon

personas.why: The arrow tells me something drops down, but not what. It could be status or account switching or my profile.

personas.expectation: I think it concerns my own account. Pressing it might show my details, or let me change the word 'Online' to something else.

personas.solution: A plain word on it, such as 'My account' or 'Change whether I appear online', so I know before I press.
